name: 90280 · South Gate, CA
findings: ZIP 90280 (South Gate) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90280 (South Gate) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90280 (South Gate) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
